title: Dark-theme cache eviction policy comparison card
what: S3-FIFO mean hit rate (%), gain over default LRU (pts), or gain over TinyLFU (pts)

reader_questions.question: Which eviction policy achieves the highest hit rate and by how much over LRU?
reader_questions.expected: S3-FIFO leads at 89.4%, beating LRU (80.8%) by +8.6 percentage points.

reader_questions.question: Is S3-FIFO's lead over TinyLFU outside trace-to-trace spread?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; S3-FIFO leads TinyLFU (85.3%) by +4.1 pts, well outside ±0.7–0.8 pt s.d.

reader_questions.question: How does S3-FIFO compare to TinyLFU on eviction CPU overhead?
reader_questions.expected: S3-FIFO uses roughly half the eviction CPU of TinyLFU (~1.4 µs vs ~2.9 µs), close to LRU (~1.2 µs).
